title: 文件字符阅读器
problem_statement_md:
你需要编写一个程序读取某个文件的指定字符数。
输入数字**N**，输出**books.txt**文件的前**N**个字符。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Reading Files[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need to make a program to read the given number of characters of a file.
Take a number [b]N[/b] as input and output the first [b]N[/b] characters of the [b]books.txt[/b] file. 
[note]The given code opens the [b]books.txt[/b] file. Use the [b]file[/b] object to read the content of the file. [/note]
hint_md: 给定的代码打开**books.txt**文件，并使用**file**对象来读取文件的内容。

code_templates.solution_code:
file = open("/usercode/books.txt") 

n = int(input()) 
l = file.read()

print(l[:n])
file.close()
